items.description: Floor cleaning, washing machine connection check, skirting board replacement (utility room and hallway)
items.rationale: Escape of water from a hose under 2.4.2; cleaning of affected surfaces 7.1.7(h), source check 7.1.7(e) and skirting as building component 4.2.2/7.1.7(a) are all repair costs in the affected rooms. Fair market flat rate for a small job.

items.description: Moisture measurement and drying of utility room and hallway floor incl. drying unit and labour
items.rationale: Covered under 7.1.7(b) and (e) (drying, moisture measurement, equipment hire) for the affected rooms; both rooms were wetted. Ordinary market price for a small drying job.

items.description: Assessment and drying of framed decorative print
items.rationale: Household contents are excluded under 4.3(d); 5.2.6 applies only to individual items of particular value, and a mass-produced poster print in a pine frame from a furniture store is not one. If it were accepted, the cost would fall well below the EUR 1,000 net cap.
